topic: round 3: contrary evidence for sirolimus found during the audit (added after the audit, not by the searches)
note: Four sentences added by the AI assistant, with the author's approval, after the second red-team review, from papers named by the audit or already cited in the report. Not a search: no queries were run. Each sentence is re-fetched by track2.verify_literature like the others.

against_or_risk.finding: TORC1 inactivation causes mitotic slippage that led to chromosome instability in budding yeast.
against_or_risk.sentence: This mitotic slippage caused chromosome instability.
against_or_risk.title: TORC1 inactivation promotes APC/C-dependent mitotic slippage in yeast and human cells.
against_or_risk.caveats: Chromosome instability was measured in yeast. TORC1 inactivation is not shown here to be the same as treatment with sirolimus at clinical exposure.

against_or_risk.finding: mTORC1 inactivation also causes mitotic slippage in human cells (chromosome instability not measured in human cells).
against_or_risk.sentence: In human cells, mammalian TORC1 (mTORC1) inactivation also invoked mitotic slippage, indicating that TORC1 inactivation-induced mitotic slippage is conserved from yeast to mammalian cells.
against_or_risk.title: TORC1 inactivation promotes APC/C-dependent mitotic slippage in yeast and human cells.
against_or_risk.caveats: Mitotic slippage is not chromosome instability; the abstract reports instability only for yeast.

against_or_risk.system: kidney-transplanted children, sirolimus against matched controls (34 and 34)
against_or_risk.finding: Sirolimus lowered growth velocity and height gain in children after kidney transplantation.
against_or_risk.sentence: SRL exerted an adverse effect on growth as demonstrated by significantly lower (p < 0.05) growth velocity (cm/year) and smaller change in height SD in the SRL group after 6 (4.08 vs. 6.56 and -0.05 vs. 0.14), 12 (4.44 vs. 6.11 and -0.03 vs. 0.28) and 24 (4.53 vs. 6.03 and -0.04 vs. 0.53) months of treatment.
against_or_risk.title: Growth of kidney-transplanted pediatric patients treated with sirolimus.
against_or_risk.caveats: Observational, in children with a kidney transplant and other treatments; not MVA.

against_or_risk.system: Drosophila neuroblasts with spindle-checkpoint genes depleted
against_or_risk.finding: The authors suggest that TOR inhibition might have a negative impact on the proliferative capacity of highly aneuploid neuroblasts.
against_or_risk.sentence: These results suggest that TOR inhibition or non-physiological levels of autophagy might have a negative impact on the proliferative capacity of highly aneuploid NBs.
against_or_risk.caveats: Authors' interpretation; the rapamycin result itself is reported in Supplementary Fig. 6C, not read here.
